source.description: SPS resin is a crystalline resin and is an engineering plastic with a long-term heat resistance of approximately 150℃. Engineering plastic is a general term for plastics with excellent heat resistance and strength. Global demand is said to be approximately 36 million tons/year, and it is mainly used in industrial products.Crystalline resins generally have high chemical resistance and are hard and rigid, while amorphous resins tend to have high transparency and stable dimensional accuracy.SPS resin combines the features of crystalline resin and those derived from polystyrene, which is an amorphous resin. It is also a resin that is located between engineering plastics and super engineering plastics (super engineering plastics) with higher heat resistance.
